name: Alfa-Bank
verdict: Largest shareholder is banker Andrey Kosogov, who took over the sanctioned co-founders' stakes. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Russia's largest private bank; title sponsor of the Russian Premier League and partner of HC Avangard since December 2025. US, EU and UK sanctioned the bank in 2022-23; sanctions records don't count towards a tier. No human-rights finding against the bank itself was found.
